verdict.rationale: Vanta's own pages describe dedicated support for HIPAA (automated evidence and guided controls for the Security and Breach Notification Rules), GDPR (privacy workflows and continuous monitoring) and PCI (reusing controls in one place). Its GRC page says controls cross-map across its pre-built frameworks, and the homepage cites 35+ frameworks, so new requirements are handled on the same platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework operation, and PCI DSS-specific requirement detail (the PCI page quotes are generic).

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool
